title: かけがえのないすべて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon and I are heading back home when she pipes up with a question.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, do you have any time available on our next day off?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No. I will explain in detail on the day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Have a good evening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, Mihono Bourbon returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'm just imagining things, but it looked like she was smiling as she left.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our day off arrives.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: We're two minutes ahead of schedule. The train should be arriving soon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That's something for you to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She somehow seems different than usual, both in her words and behavior.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Does this have something to do with that whole "precious memories" thing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I might not know what we're doing yet, but it's surely nothing bad. I decide to just be quiet and follow her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: We're here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. When I was young, I once went with my parents to train near a farm.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: On our way home, we shared a meal at the farm.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I thought I would like to do the same with you, so I invited you here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. First, let's take a look around. Later, we can get some ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have a map of the farm's interior recorded to memory. I know where all the facilities are located, so please leave navigation to me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Now, I will set our destination, and we will hurry to…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …No, we should take our time. I have determined there is no reason to rush.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, Master.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We take a long look around the farm, surrounded by the nostalgic smell of fresh grass.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After we finish lunch and eat some ice cream, Mihono Bourbon calmly opens up a conversation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I believe that I have created a "precious" memory with you today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Up until now, I didn't understand what "precious" meant, nor did I comprehend the criteria for determining such importance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It was challenging…
choice_data_list: Just relax and take it slow.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …To put it simply, what I lacked was not understanding, but realization.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: After seeing you work so hard for my sake, I finally realized it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: To me, the regular days that we take for granted are the ones I treasure the most.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: When I decided on my dream as a child, my parents did everything they could to support me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I would train with Father every day without fail, and Mother would watch over us.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I don't have many memories of playing around like other children, but…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see now that I spent much more time with my parents than most of my peers.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: And to me, that is irreplaceable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: They were joyous times.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Whether it was my daily training, or simply a meal with my family…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Those were all "precious" memories to me.
choice_data_list: It sounds like that was a wonderful time for you.
It sounds like that was a wonderful time for you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Y-yes… That's correct.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So… back then, when I couldn't respond immediately when asked about "precious" memories with you…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It confused me, but now I realize the reason is actually quite simple.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It is because all of my time with you is precious to me.
choice_data_list: It makes me happy to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It is because all of my time with you is precious to me.
choice_data_list: It makes me happy to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have determined that this very moment is the same.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, continuing in this manner may be problematic in the future.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: At this rate, my memory log will likely become inundated with memories of you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This must be addressed immediately. Please tell me how I can rectify this issue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon snaps back to her usual self, but I can see a faint smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Do you… mean that?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Training with you makes me feel the same warmth in my heart that I did as a child.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So I believe that this too will become a "precious" memory.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But… Maybe it's a little…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There's something different about this "precious" feeling compared to what I felt as a child.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It makes you happy?
choice_data_list: Of course. I'm happy that you appreciate our time together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I… um, I… The time I spend training with you… Even this very moment…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It is all… very precious to me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I do not understand the meaning of your gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon mutters this faint reply while averting her gaze.
